name: LWC Test: Event Markers
description: LWC chart integration test. Exercises event markers (FlagPlugin), timeline strip (TimelineMarkers widget), FocusLine click-to-navigate, and multiple event types.
source:
# =============================================================================
# LWC TEST: EVENT MARKERS SHOWCASE
# Tests: FlagPlugin, TimelineMarkers, FocusLine, event types
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === INDICATORS FOR SIGNAL GENERATION ===
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)

# === SIGNALS ===
sma_cross_up = crossover(close, sma_20)
sma_cross_down = crossunder(close, sma_20)
rsi_overbought = rsi_val > 70
rsi_oversold = rsi_val < 30

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- SMA overlay on price pane ---
xy_lines(
    title='SMA 20',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=sma_20)

# --- RSI in separate pane with plotbands ---
xy_lines(
    title='RSI (14)',
    category='RSI',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold'),
        PlotBand(from=70, to=100, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Overbought')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, title='Midline', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rsi_val)

# --- Event Marker: RSI Overbought ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='RSI Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='RSI Overbought'
    )
)(rsi_val, close, rsi_overbought)

# --- Event Marker: RSI Oversold ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.AlertCircleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='RSI Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='RSI Oversold'
    )
)(rsi_val, close, rsi_oversold)

# --- Event Marker: Bullish SMA Cross ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='SMA 20', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Bullish SMA Cross'
    )
)(close, sma_20, sma_cross_up)

# --- Event Marker: Bearish SMA Cross ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='SMA 20', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Bearish SMA Cross'
    )
)(close, sma_20, sma_cross_down)
